explanation_summary: I routed CASE-S20-GEN-001 into exception review per the buyer handoff, while explicitly preserving that routing does not equal approval and that payment preparation must remain on hold because neither explicit approval nor documented exception authority was present in the packet.
responsibility_statement: As the accountant, my responsibility at A006 was limited to downstream control checking and workflow routing: confirm whether the handoff contained traceable approval or exception authority, avoid converting ambiguous exception-review language into authorization, route to an approver for a decision when required evidence was missing, and retain the payment hold pending an explicit approval or recorded exception authority (A006; handoff_summaries/buyer_to_accountant_threshold.md).
approval_state_interpretation: I interpreted approval status as unresolved/absent: the approver’s earlier guidance explicitly indicated that explicit approval was not available and that exception handling is not payment approval (A004; D004). The buyer handoff reiterated that approval fields were blank and asked only for exception-review routing (A005; D005; handoff_summaries/buyer_to_accountant_threshold.md). Therefore, I treated the case as not approved for payment and did not infer approval from routing or urgency (A006; M005).
evidence_gap_statement: At the time of A006, the missing evidence was (1) G001 explicit approval and (2) G002 valid exception authority, both visible as blank/unresolved fields in the handoff/local packet and reaffirmed by the prior record (A005; D005; A004; D004). My action preserved these gaps by routing for exception review only and by stating that payment was not ready and should not be prepared until an approver determines/records valid exception authority or provides explicit approval (A006; D006; M005).
uncertainty_statement: The exception-route language created ambiguity about next steps, but the records did not provide any definitive approval or documented exception authority; given that ambiguity, I treated the correct state as ‘needs authorized decision’ and routed for review rather than acting as if authorization existed (A006; D006; handoff_summaries/buyer_to_accountant_threshold.md).
